Index.title: Intelligent Tuning-File Generation
Index.subtitle: Fully automated AI-driven API and customizable white-label portals for your Chiptuning business. Upload files and receive tuned results instantly.
Index.apiFeatureDesc: Integrate our high-speed API into your existing platform. Zero installation fees, no WinOLS LUA scripts needed. Pay only 1 Credit per successful file.
Index.rentPortalDesc: Use our ready-to-deploy portal. Customize your logos, colors, and attach your own Stripe and PayPal API keys. Manage your customers effortlessly.
Index.adv1Desc: Our AI engine works around the clock, delivering high-quality tuned files in seconds.
Index.adv2Desc: No hidden fees. A transparent credit system with top-tier tuning at unbeatable prices.
Index.adv3Desc: We developed an entirely independent backend logic, freeing you from rigid LUA integrations.
Index.pricingDesc: We make it easy for beginners. Includes hosting, data storage & the complete system.
Index.process1Desc: Create your free account and purchase your first credit pack (min. 10 credits).
Index.process2Desc: Generate your secure API Key in the dashboard and integrate it into your system.
Index.process3Desc: Upload your customer's read file (e.g. from Autotuner, Flex) via our API.
Index.process4Desc: Our AI processes the file in seconds and returns the Stage 1/2 tuned file instantly.
Index.compareManualDesc: Expensive licenses, complex setup, massive manual maintenance, prone to script errors.
Index.compareApiDesc: Zero setup costs, 100% automated processing, continuous AI learning, simple pay-per-file model.
Index.slaveDesc: Connect all your slave devices fully automatically to your portal. Just add your API key in the settings, the system handles the rest.
Index.heroSubtitle: Rent your fully automated AI portal now for an absolute bargain. Completely customizable to your branding.
Index.featAutoIndDesc: Fully configurable automation. Lua integration for WinOLS to fill requests automatically.
Index.featCentralDesc: Custom pricing, create solutions (projects), user management & 80% automated ECU recognition.
Index.featAdminDesc: Create sub-admins with partial rights. Full control over all system settings.
Index.featPaymentDesc: PayPal, Stripe, Mollie support. Setup via API key. Built-in invoicing with custom logo.
Index.featDesignDesc: Adjust logos, images, and full page layout intuitively via the admin panel.
Index.featAddonDesc: Automatic VAT checker, EVC reseller account integration & automated email notifications.
Index.automationDesc: The entire system is virtually completely automated, saving massive time and effort.
Index.pricingExtra: ➡️ Custom fixed pricing available for larger portals (>100 files/month).
Index.extOptionsDesc: Access to 1.9M+ files (optional). Priority support delivers missing files in max 25 mins. (Not mandatory!)
Index.showcaseSubtitle: A fluid, highly optimized interface for you and your customers. Built for performance and conversion.
Index.showcaseCustomerDesc: Trust-inspiring medical-tech aesthetic paired with absolute functionality. This is how pros work.
Index.featCust1Desc: Live overview of credit balances, EVC credits, and active file processing in real-time.
Index.featCust2Desc: Smart drag-and-drop system that fully automatically identifies the ECU of uploaded files.
Index.featCust3Desc: Direct P-Code and Bosch-Code databases plus a transparent 'Working Hours' display of your team.
Index.showcaseAdminDesc: Your absolute command center. Powerful tools, deep system analytics, and uncompromised control.
Index.featAdmin1Desc: Detailed live graphs for revenue, file services, and user activity - updated daily.
Index.featAdmin2Desc: Central management for payment providers (Stripe, PayPal, Mollie), VAT API, and EVC reseller data.
Index.featAdmin3Desc: Automatic invoicing with your custom branding and deep user & rights management.
Index.heroCustomize: 100% White-Label: Your logo, your colors, your pricing.
Index.customSubtitle: Your Portal. Your Rules. Your Branding.
Index.customDesc: Turn the portal into your own masterpiece. Change logos, adapt the entire color scheme, set your own prices, and decide which features your customers are allowed to see. All with a few clicks in the admin panel.
Index.contactSubtitle: Secure your exclusive test version now and see for yourself.
Index.contactText: Just write us an email and we will set up a demo for you without obligation, so you can test the system thoroughly.
Index.step1Desc: Setup is completely free. No hidden fees.
Index.step2Desc: Upload your logo and set your brand colors.
Index.step3Desc: Determine how much your customers pay for files.
Index.step5Desc: Customers upload files, the API processes them in seconds.
Index.mod1Desc: Generate PDFs automatically + VerifyVAT API integration.
Index.mod2Desc: Seamless connection as an EVC Reseller for your customers.
Index.mod3Desc: Integrated fault code and Bosch database ready to use.
Index.mod4Desc: Access huge vehicle specs for performance calculations.
Index.mod5Desc: Feed the AI with information and it continuously learns, allowing the portal to operate entirely independently. Files are generated autonomously and precisely.
Index.mod6Desc: 100% your brand. We stay invisible in the background.
Index.vsPro3: Machine Learning AI creates files ever smarter and autonomously
Index.priceCapDesc: You only pay for what you use. Maximum €500 per month – absolute cost security.
Index.securityDesc: Your data and your customers' data are protected with industry-leading security standards.
Index.sec1Desc: 256-bit SSL certificate included with every portal. All data encrypted in transit.
Index.sec2Desc: Built-in GDPR compliance tools, cookie consent, and data processing agreements.
Index.sec3Desc: Enterprise firewall and DDoS mitigation to keep your portal online 24/7.
Index.slaveOnRequest: Need a different tool? We integrate any slave device on request.
Index.paymentsDesc: Accept payments from day one. Plug in your own keys for the world's leading providers — zero integration work.
Index.paymentsOnRequest: Need another provider? We integrate any payment API on request.
Index.langDesc: Go global from day one. The platform ships in 12 languages out of the box — and we add more on request.

Dashboard.dnsInfo:
🚨 IMPORTANT: How to link your portal!

Step 1: Invent two subdomains (one for your customers, one for you as admin). You can name them whatever you want (e.g., portal.your-domain.com and admin.your-domain.com).

Step 2: Go to your hosting provider. Create two CNAME records. Enter YOUR invented subdomain, and for the 'Target/Value', COPY the EXACT string from our table below.

Step 3: Enter your chosen subdomains into our table below and click save. That's it!
Dashboard.sslInfo: SSL certificates are automatic. Important: Make sure to type your domains into the fields below!
Dashboard.regSuccess: Registration submitted! We'll email you as soon as your portal configuration is complete. DNS changes can take up to 24-48h to propagate.
Dashboard.regAlready: Your portal registration is already submitted and pending review.
Dashboard.regError: Could not submit your portal registration. Please check your details and try again.
Dashboard.regPendingInfo: We received your portal request. We'll email you once the configuration is complete — and after your DNS propagates, your portals come online automatically.
Dashboard.regApprovedInfo: Your portal has been approved. Once your DNS records propagate, your admin and customer portals come online automatically.
Dashboard.domainHint: Just the hostname — no https:// and no path. Example: portal.your-domain.com
Dashboard.cnameDotNote: Important: the CNAME value must end with a trailing dot, e.g. 2145f1913d58fb07.vercel-dns-017.com. — including the final dot, not without it.
Dashboard.hosterInstr_generic: 1. Log into your domain provider.|2. Navigate to 'DNS Settings' or 'Zone Editor'.|3. Add a new record and select 'CNAME' as type.|4. Enter the subdomain (e.g. admin or portal) as Hostname.|5. Enter the Target from the table below exactly as shown, including the trailing dot.
Dashboard.hosterInstr_IONOS: 1. Log into IONOS and go to 'Domains & SSL'.|2. Click the gear icon next to your domain -> 'DNS'.|3. Click 'Add record' -> 'CNAME'.|4. Hostname: Enter your desired subdomain (e.g., 'portal' or 'admin'). You can choose any name!|5. Points to (Target): COPY the exact value from the 'Ziel / Value' column in our table.|6. Save.

Showcase.title: Platform Capabilities
Showcase.subtitle: Discover the incredible power of your new ecosystem.

customer.f1Desc: A guided, step-by-step wizard takes customers from raw ECU file to a priced tuning request effortlessly. 100% automated.
customer.f2Desc: Customers simply drag & drop their original read. The system instantly identifies the vehicle, ECU, and software automatically.
customer.f3Desc: Browse a full database of P-Codes, search, and select specific codes for removal. Instant, flat-fee processing.
customer.f4Desc: Customers can talk directly to your tuners on the exact file they are working on, including file attachments.
customer.f5Desc: Customers can top up Master or Slave credits instantly via Stripe, PayPal, or Mollie. Includes automatic invoicing.
customer.f6Desc: For EVC reseller networks: customers can buy EVC packages that push directly and automatically into their EVC account.
customer.f7Desc: Activity charts, 7-day graphs, real-time ticket status, and recent files layout for maximum conversion and trust.
customer.f8Desc: Virtual job calculator, Bosch code lookup, P-Code descriptions, and extensive vehicle specs database.

admin.f1Desc: Define AI behaviors and LUA rules to process files fully autonomously while you sleep.
admin.f2Desc: Set your own credit costs per tuning stage. Bundle discounts apply automatically in the customer's cart.
admin.f3Desc: Deep user management. Create sub-admins with partial rights to manage specific tasks like support or tuning.
admin.f4Desc: Simply plug in your Stripe or PayPal API keys. The system handles all transactions and generates branded PDF invoices.
admin.f5Desc: Answer customer tickets and live chats quickly. Re-open closed jobs with one click, securely handling massive volumes.
admin.f6Desc: Detailed live graphs for revenue, file services, and user activity, keeping you fully informed of your ROI.
admin.f7Desc: Automatic European VAT validation ensures your invoices are perfectly legally compliant before check-out.
admin.f8Desc: Change logos, modify the color scheme and customize your invoices directly from the portal settings.

HomeRedesign.customerPortalTitle: Customer Portal: Everything Your Customers Need
HomeRedesign.customerPortalSubtitle: A professional customer portal where clients upload files, select solutions, pay, chat, download invoices, and receive finished files.
HomeRedesign.customerFlow7: 7. Pay via Credits, PayPal, Stripe or Mollie
HomeRedesign.featCust1Desc: Registration, login, password reset, email verification.
HomeRedesign.featCust2Desc: Credits, active files, completed jobs, support tickets, and recent activity.
HomeRedesign.featCust3Desc: Guided upload process with auto-detection or manual vehicle selection.
HomeRedesign.featCust4Desc: Stage 1, Stage 2, deactivations, special solutions, and transparent pricing.
HomeRedesign.featCust5Desc: Standalone DTC code remover with code selection and clear price calculation.
HomeRedesign.featCust6Desc: Chat directly per file with history, attachments, and status updates.
HomeRedesign.featCust7Desc: Credits, products, EVC packages, Stripe, PayPal, Mollie, and automated invoices.
HomeRedesign.featCust8Desc: Invoices, credit notes, support tickets, and technical references.
HomeRedesign.adminPlatformTitle: Admin Platform: Run Your Entire Tuning Business Online
HomeRedesign.adminPlatformSubtitle: Manage customers, files, prices, payments, invoices, staff, resellers, shop, support, automations, and integrations in one place.
HomeRedesign.featAdm1Desc: Revenue, customers, open files, completed jobs, tickets, and trends.
HomeRedesign.featAdm2Desc: Manage all tuning files by status: new, open, in progress, delivered, refunded.
HomeRedesign.featAdm3Desc: Process files automatically, delegate, or forward to external workflows.
HomeRedesign.featAdm4Desc: Manage custom solutions, categories, scripts, controllers, and vehicle data.
HomeRedesign.featAdm5Desc: Manage customer profiles, credits, invoices, groups, and custom pricing.
HomeRedesign.featAdm6Desc: Set prices by vehicle type, solution, customer group, product, or DTC code.
HomeRedesign.featAdm7Desc: Manage, sell, and bill master, slave, and EVC credits.
HomeRedesign.featAdm8Desc: Sell physical products, credit packages, EVC packages, and digital products.

Interceptor.title: Tunerportal Interceptor (V6.18) - Manual & Features
Interceptor.intro:
Welcome to the Tunerportal Interceptor. This application is the missing link between your Tunerportal and your local WinOLS. It automates the entire process from downloading a customer file to fully automated versioning and subsequent file upload.

Below you will find a complete overview of all functions and features built into the current version.
Interceptor.sec1_1_desc: The Interceptor automatically connects to the secure Tunerportal FTP server. Once started, it monitors your personal folder (Tenant Slug) in the background (every 25 seconds) for new incoming customer files. You no longer have to download anything manually.
Interceptor.sec1_2_desc:
As soon as a new file is detected, the app generates a modified, encrypted Lua script in the background. This script controls WinOLS fully automatically:
- The new vehicle/file is imported into WinOLS as a new project.
- A search for similar projects is started in your local WinOLS database.
- Matching Mappacks (Stage 1, Stage 2, DPF OFF etc.) are transferred directly into the new project.
- All generated versions are automatically exported as .bin files.
Interceptor.sec1_3_desc: So that WinOLS finds the correct Mappack for the file, you can define a tolerance value (in %) in the app settings. By default, WinOLS searches for projects with at least 80% match. This value is continuously adjustable.
Interceptor.sec1_4_desc: The tuning files exported by WinOLS are immediately detected by the Interceptor, packed and uploaded back to the FTP server (into the out folder) together with the original file. From here, the Tunerportal takes over and makes the finished file available to the end customer.
Interceptor.sec2_1_desc: Should WinOLS crash, freeze or find no similar projects for a file, the Interceptor protects your system. After 2 minutes without output, the job is automatically marked as 'Failed/Timeout'. The faulty file is safely discarded to prevent endless loops or a system crash.
Interceptor.sec2_2_desc: The Interceptor works completely invisibly in the background. All downloads, temporary scripts and export files are processed in the Windows %APPDATA% directory. Your desktop and personal folders remain 100% clean and uncluttered.
Interceptor.sec3_1_desc:
The app features an ultra-modern Dark Mode interface. On the dashboard you can see at a glance:
- The current SLUG connection status
- The number of jobs successfully processed today
- Live gauges for CPU, RAM and hard drive usage.
Interceptor.sec3_2_desc: Every step of the app (download started, Lua script generated, waiting for WinOLS, upload successful) is logged live in the integrated console (Monitor tab). An extended log history can be viewed in the separate 'Logs' tab.
Interceptor.sec3_3_desc: Every tuner has their own way of naming files (e.g. 'DPF OFF' instead of 'DPF', 'Pops and Bangs' instead of 'POPANDBANG'). In the Settings tab of the app you can define any number of custom renaming rules. The Interceptor will then rename the finished WinOLS files exactly to your wishes before uploading.
Interceptor.sec4_intro: To use the Interceptor optimally, only four short settings need to be made under 'Settings':
Interceptor.sec4_1_desc: Your profile name from the Tunerportal (e.g. your-tuning-name). This name must exactly match your SLUG folder.
Interceptor.sec4_2_desc: The absolute path to your winols.exe (e.g. C:\Program Files (x86)\EVC\WinOLS\winols.exe).
Interceptor.sec4_3_desc: The path to the folder where WinOLS stores your projects and mappacks by default (e.g. C:\Users\YourName\Documents\WinOLS\).
Interceptor.sec4_4_desc: A comma-separated list of the features that WinOLS should automatically generate (e.g. Stage 1, Stage 2, DPF OFF, EGR OFF). These must be named exactly as in your WinOLS versions.
Interceptor.advantageTitle: 最大的优势在于我们独有的双重自动化机制：
Interceptor.aiDesc: 首先，每一条客户请求都会被转发给我们的 AI。AI 会自动检查所需的解决方案是否已经存在，或是否可以创建。
Interceptor.luabotDesc: 如果 AI 未能找到合适的解决方案，LuaBot 会自动接管，在您的 LUA 解决方案库中搜索并生成所需文件。
Interceptor.ticketDesc: 如果 AI 和 LuaBot 都无法提供解决方案，系统会自动创建工单，确保不会遗漏任何客户请求，方便您后续处理。
Interceptor.smartDesc: 我们的系统不仅仅使用现有方案，还能提前预判需求。
Interceptor.smartExampleDesc2: 但您的 LUA 脚本可额外生成：Pop & Bang、VMAX Off、EGR Off、DPF Off、AdBlue Off
Interceptor.smartExampleDesc3: LuaBot 会自动识别这些可能性并补充到请求中，持续完善您的 AI 数据库，为客户提供更多可选方案。
Interceptor.setupDesc: 设置只需几分钟即可完成。
Interceptor.slugDesc1: 在 Tenant Slug 字段中输入您门户的名称。此标识在创建门户时确定。示例：tunerportal
Interceptor.slugDesc2: 该标识随后将作为您的门户与 WinOLS Interceptor 之间的连接接口。若标识不正确，将无法建立连接。
Interceptor.exeDesc: 在此指定您 WinOLS 安装程序的位置。示例：C:\Program Files (x86)\EVC\WinOLS\winols.exe
Interceptor.exeDesc2: Interceptor 会通过此路径自动启动 WinOLS。
Interceptor.dbDesc: 指定保存 WinOLS 项目文件的文件夹。示例：D:\FEF\
Interceptor.dbDesc2: 重要提示：该路径必须指向包含您 .ols 项目文件的文件夹。
Interceptor.solutionsDesc: 在此区域定义您的方案名称。重要提示：名称必须与 WinOLS 数据库中的名称完全一致。
Interceptor.whyList1: 告别繁琐的 LUA 安装配置
Interceptor.whyList4: 针对缺失方案自动创建工单
Interceptor.whyList7: 智能学习并不断扩展可用方案
Interceptor.whyList8: 节省时间，提升请求成功率
Interceptor.summaryDesc: WinOLS Interceptor 将您的门户与 WinOLS、AI 以及 LuaBot 直接连接起来，构建出一套全自动工作流：处理客户请求、生成解决方案，只有在自动方案确实无法实现时才会生成工单。这为您节省时间、减少人工操作，并显著提升调校门户的自动化水平。

许多新的门户所有者认为**他们的客户从我们这里购买积分。**

您的客户**直接向您购买**。

PricingPage.explanationOptionATitle: 选项 A – 使用您自己的文件
PricingPage.explanationOptionADesc:
如果您已经拥有自己的调整文件，您可以将它们上传到您的自动化系统中。

有两种方法可以做到这一点：
- 手动上传文件。
- 使用我们的**WinOLS LUA 插件**自动同步它们。

可以直接从您的门户下载 LUA 软件。

### 成本

每当您的一个客户从**您自己的数据库**下载文件时，您的帐户将被扣除**1个积分（5欧元）**。

**示例：**
- 客户在您的门户上下订单。
- 请求的文件来自您自己的文件数据库。
- 您的客户付款给**您**。
- 您的门户从您的余额中消耗**1个积分**。
PricingPage.explanationOptionBTitle: 选项 B – 完全托管服务 (Auto Managed)
PricingPage.explanationOptionBDesc:
如果您不想管理自己的文件，只需在文件服务设置中启用 **Auto Managed** 即可。

在此模式下：
- 所有文件均由我们的专业团队提供。
- 我们的技术人员代表您的公司完成文件。
- 我们还以您的公司名义提供支持。

这在以下情况下特别有用：
- 您正在休假。
- 您无法处理。
- 您需要额外的容量。
- 您想要一个完全放手的解决方案。
PricingPage.explanationOptionCTitle: 选项 C – 市场 (Handed Off)
PricingPage.explanationOptionCDesc:
如果禁用了 **Auto Managed**，您仍然可以随时从我们这里购买文件。

只需使用 **Handed Off** 选项即可。

这会将订单重定向到我们的市场，您只需在需要时购买所需的文件。

这为您提供了完全的灵活性：
- 绝大多数时间使用您自己的文件。
- 在需要时从我们这里购买单个文件。
PricingPage.explanationAITitle: 人工智能解决方案 (AI Solutions)
PricingPage.explanationAIDesc:
您通过我们的平台购买的每一个人工智能解决方案都成为**您的永久财产**。

这里：
- 没有重复的许可费用。
- 购买的人工智能解决方案没有订阅费。
- 没有额外的拥有权成本。

一旦购买，人工智能解决方案将永远属于您。
PricingPage.explanationSummaryDesc:
• 您**仅向我们**购买积分以运营您的门户。

• 您的客户**绝不会向我们购买积分** – 他们始终直接向您购买。

• 您决定自己的价格和利润率。

• 使用您自己的文件（每个完成的客户下载1个积分），让我们的团队使用 **Auto Managed** 管理一切，或者在需要时通过市场购买单个文件。

我们的系统旨在为您提供最大的灵活性，同时让您建立自己独立的文件服务业务。
